persona: Senior customer care agent and acting team leader in an inbound voice process
resumeText:
Rahul Verma | Noida | rahul.verma@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Customer Care Associate and Acting Team Leader, Brightline Contact Solutions, Noida (2021 - present)
- Led a team of 14 agents in the domestic voice process for a telecom client during the team leader's absence.
- Tracked AHT, CSAT and first call resolution for the team every day and shared hourly updates.
- Conducted call monitoring and one-on-one coaching sessions with new agents on soft skills.
- Took escalation handling for irate customers that agents could not close on the first call.
- Prepared the daily team MIS in Excel with login hours and call volumes for the operations manager.
- Ran morning huddles on process updates and briefed the team on daily targets.

Customer Care Associate, Brightline Contact Solutions, Noida (2019 - 2021)
- Answered 80 to 100 inbound calls a day on billing and plan queries in Salesforce Service Cloud.

SKILLS
Roster adherence, Agent scorecards, Salesforce

EDUCATION
B.Com, Chaudhary Charan Singh University, 2019
